b:
Roaring
waves
always
keep rising
in his
heart

Yet he
is empty,
without a ripple

He enjoys
the light
after the storm

as though he did not know
what he knows,
that there will be
a storm tomorrow

In an impermanent
life
his
moments
are for friendship
alone

Blossom
in it
as flowers

He has
no need
for thorns
